title: Palo Alto Prisma Access or Zscaler: Choosing a SASE Platform
excerpt: Both deliver security from the cloud for remote users and branches. Prisma Access extends an existing Palo Alto estate; Zscaler was built as a cloud service from the beginning.
verdict: Prisma Access makes most sense for organisations already invested in Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, where policy and skills carry over. Zscaler is a mature, specialised choice for organisations starting a SASE strategy without an existing vendor commitment.

spec1.label: Fit with existing Palo Alto infrastructure
